title: Campaign: human motor cortex structure, geometry and within-session decoding
abstract: Branch A of the human motor cortex structure campaign asks: Geometry: how many dimensions does motor cortex activity use during a BCI task, and how does within-session decoding depend on electrode count, feature type and array? It splits by whether the claim is about activity statistics or about decoding into leaves A1: Within a session, is the covariance eigenspectrum of motor cortex activity better described by a power law than by an exponential decay?; A2: How does within-session decoding depend on electrode count, feature type and array; in particular, does it keep growing with electrode count or saturate? No results yet. Cite this campaign and name the leaf to contribute.
